sections.label: Lessons Tailored to You
text: Lessons Tailored to You
Every student learns differently, so every lesson plan is built around your goals, your pace, and the music you actually want to play or sing.
Piano, for Children
A friendly, structured introduction to the piano covering reading, technique, and theory through pieces children genuinely enjoy playing — from film themes to first classical pieces.
Singing, for Children
Healthy vocal technique taught in a fun, low-pressure way, building breath support, pitch, and confidence — ideal for school choirs, shows, or simply the love of singing.
Piano, for Adults
Whether you're returning after years away or starting from scratch, adult lessons focus on steady, satisfying progress at whatever pace suits your schedule and ambitions.
Singing, for Adults
Technique-led lessons that build range, control, and stage confidence, suited to everything from choir auditions to weddings, musical theatre, or simply singing for pleasure.
Exam Preparation
Structured, exam-focused teaching for ABRSM and Trinity piano and singing exams, from Initial Grade through to Grade 8, including theory support alongside your practical work.
In-Person & Online
Lessons at my teaching studio in Cambridge, or online via video call for students further afield or those who prefer the flexibility of learning from home.

sections.label: Frequently Asked Questions
text: Frequently Asked Questions
What age can my child start lessons?

Most children start piano from around age 6 and singing from around age 7, once they have the concentration and physical coordination to get real benefit from lessons. I'm happy to have a short chat beforehand if you're not sure whether your child is ready.
Do I need my own piano or keyboard?

Yes, regular practice between lessons makes a big difference to progress. A full-size, weighted keyboard is a good minimum requirement for piano students; I'm happy to advise on suitable options if you're buying one.
Where do lessons take place?
In-person lessons are held at my teaching studio in central Cambridge, with free on-street parking nearby. Online lessons are available via Zoom for those who prefer to learn from home.
How do I pay for lessons?
Lessons are invoiced termly by bank transfer, in line with local school term dates. Full details are provided once your regular lesson slot is confirmed.
What if we need to cancel a lesson?
I ask for at least 24 hours' notice where possible. Lessons cancelled with less notice can't usually be refunded, but I'll always try to offer a makeup slot where I have availability.
